title: Does removing a second AI verification call make Med Agent Hub twice as fast on a laptop without sacrificing safety?
summary: Earlier Med Agent Hub setups ran a second AI model pass after every answer to double-check citations, doubling wait times on local hardware. On an Apple Silicon laptop running Google Gemma 4 12B, we tested replacing that second AI pass with fast rule-based date and citation checks — comparing Med Agent Hub's true single-call path head-to-head against built-in ChartSearchAI across three HIV patients and 35 clinical questions per setup.
takeaway: Replacing the second AI pass with deterministic checks cut Med Agent Hub's median answer wait in half (21.7s down to 10.8s, with post-answer checking dropping from 4.9s to under 0.5s) while outscoring built-in ChartSearchAI by +16.1 points (85.6 vs. 69.5/100). Med Agent Hub recorded zero unsafe answers and zero wrong dates, compared with 3 unsafe answers and 2 wrong dates on built-in ChartSearchAI.
